note: meta=null means the Meta bridge detected no active ad for this SKU in its last-3-days window. meta.campaigns[] lists the active campaigns behind that SKU (objective=null means the campaign was not found in campaigns.json). Per campaign entry: adName is the showing ad's name, or null when several ads of that campaign show the SKU — then ads[] lists {adName, spend3dUSD} per ad. spend7dUSD/purchases7d are the 7-day-window equivalents of the 3-day fields (from ad-level Meta insights, matched by SKU in ad name; null when no 7d data). purchases7d counts Meta action type 'omni_purchase' (fallback 'purchase') — the Ads Manager Purchases column; offsite_conversion.* excluded, no double counting).
